pr.title: Work the band from the keyboard, and list a drawer's actions with their keys
pr.head: 6d449c5a8a1f9940fa7024011a7d9c201dd64454

summary: Projector's band is the strip Projector draws above the Claude Code prompt. It lists the session's pull requests and the inbox items agents post: questions, which wait for your answer, and notices, which only need a read. Clicking a line opens its drawer, which shows the item's detail, a question's options, and actions such as discuss, dismiss, and snooze.

Before this change, a question's options were Markdown links that only a mouse click could press. On Claude Code's main screen, which runs under tmux and takes no clicks, the only way to answer was to type the question's quote and the option by hand. This change makes the band work from the keyboard, the way Claude Code's own surveys do:

• Options take digits. An open question's options are plain Buttons on 1 to 6. A digit presses one while the band holds the keyboard. The docs also promise a digit typed first into an empty prompt, but the owner's live test found that such a digit does not reach the band. Pressing an option only fills the prompt; sending the prompt unchanged is what answers.
  • Actions take letters. Each drawer action is a line of its own: d: discuss question, x: dismiss question (or restore), and s: snooze question (or unsnooze), each naming what it acts on. A pull request's drawer reads d: discuss PR and x: dismiss PR above its links. Letters work only while the band holds the keyboard, never from the prompt.
  • Enter carries the focus ring. Enter on a line opens its drawer and moves the ring onto the first option, or onto discuss. Enter on the open line closes it and puts the ring back on the line.
  • Snooze asks how long. It offers 15 min | 1 hour | 4 hours | 1 day | cancel and snoozes nothing until you pick a length.

The change also restyles the band: every item takes a - bullet, an open question's line takes the theme color permission, the pull request drawer's links read open in github and open in projector, and its facts line takes a color per piece: each loop its own, the branch the palette's cyan, and the size as a green and red diff stat. The open-thread count reads 5⋮. The inbox plan's § 15 and § 16 record each decision and why.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Band: the region Projector draws above the prompt, Claude Code's AbovePrompt site.
  • Drawer: the detail a line opens under it. One drawer is open at a time, in the bandDrawer atom.
  • Focus ring: Claude Code's inverted highlight on the band element that Enter presses while the band holds the keyboard.
  • Hotkey: a Button's one-character key. Claude Code arms it while the band holds the keyboard, and also arms a bare digit typed into an empty prompt.
  • Proposal: the band's record of what a drawer put in the prompt, which readPrompt uses to tell an answer from a reply.

groups.title: The drawer's keys and the focus ring
groups.kicker: How the band draws options and actions as keyed lines, moves the ring, and asks how long to snooze.
intro: All of the behavior lives in the band's render hook in hooks/register.tsx. A question's options become plain Buttons with a digit hotkey, and each action becomes a plain Button with a letter. Claude Code draws a plain Button's hotkey before its label, as 1: Decline it, so the band draws no numbers of its own. The pull request drawer draws its two actions under its facts line and its links after them.

Claude Code's ui.press event does not say whether a click or Enter pressed a Button. So a new ui.focus hook records which element the ring last landed on, in the module variable ring. A press on the element under the ring counts as Enter, and the band then calls $.ui.focus to move the ring into the drawer or back onto the line. Nothing tells the band when it loses the keyboard, so ring can be stale after Esc. Claude Code refuses $.ui.focus for a band that no longer holds the keyboard, and the band logs the refusal to the debug log.

Snooze now sets a second atom, bandSnoozing, to the open drawer's key. While it is set, the drawer draws the lengths and cancel in place of its actions. A length runs project inbox snooze <n> --for <minutes>.

checks.text: Letters cannot fire from the prompt. Claude Code 2.1.296's declarations for Button.hotkey say a band hotkey presses only while the band holds the focus, never from the composer, except a bare digit in an empty one. Every action Button is drawn only inside the one open drawer, which only a press on its line opens.
Ran claude plugin test . at 6d449c5: 117 pass, 0 fail. Type-checked hooks/ with tsc against Claude Code 2.1.296's declarations, with no errors.

files.note: The render hook: keyed option and action lines, the ui.focus hook and carry, the snooze lengths, and the restyled lines.

checks.text: The longest length, 1440 minutes, is within the CLI's cap. inbox.snooze in src/projector/inbox.py accepts 0 to MAX_SNOOZE_MINUTES, which is 24 * 60.

ring is the band's only record of where the focus ring is. It is written only by the ui.focus hook below, and it can be stale after Esc, since Claude Code raises no event when the band loses the keyboard.

Every path that closes a drawer goes through closeDrawer, which also clears bandSnoozing, and only toggle opens one, also clearing it. So a drawer always opens on its actions, never on the lengths. Checked by finding every writer of both atoms.
carry treats a press as Enter when the ring is on the pressed element. Plan § 15.3 rests this on the owner's observation that a click on a Button does not move the ring.
The ring targets match the keys the drawer draws: snooze-15:<ref> and cancel:<ref> from drawLengths, snooze:<ref> and discuss:<ref> from drawActions, and answer:<ref>.a from drawAnswers.
An open item's line is keyed close:<ref>. Claude Code keeps the ring by position, and the open item has the band to itself, so the move back onto item:<ref> waits until the band draws the list again.

BRANCH_COLOR and LOOP_COLORS use ansi256() slots so the colors follow your terminal palette. Plan § 16.1 records that the owner found that Claude Code draws a plain name such as cyan in the default color and refuses an ansi: name on the band.

files.note: Declares the new bandSnoozing atom: the drawer that is asking how long to snooze.
A doc comment now says an answer is what pressing an option puts in the prompt, since the option is no longer a numbered link.

groups.title: Tests
groups.kicker: Band tests for digits, letters, the ring, snooze lengths, and the restyled lines.
intro: Existing tests press answer: Buttons in place of links and pick a snooze length after pressing snooze. New tests pin each new behavior. Claude Code's test kit serves no $.ui.focus, so keyboardOf raises ui.focus to place the ring and reads which element the band tried to move the ring onto from the debug line the band writes when the kit refuses.

files.note: New tests for the digit options, the action letters and labels, the ring moves, snooze lengths, keyed-line colors, and bullets.

checks.text: keyboardOf stands in for Enter: it places the ring with a person-origin ui.focus, then the test presses the same key. A plain ui.press without it stands in for a click.
